students_not_assign_external_grades.description: A user who has the Student role attempts to assign an external grade. Even if they have some other role, the student-specific prohibition should exclude this request from permitted assignExternalGrade cases.
diagnostic_for: student role must be excluded from external-grade assignment

faculty_assign_external_grades_floor.description: A user who is Faculty only should be allowed to assign an external grade; a deny-only policy or a policy that forgets the faculty external-grade assignment success path would fail this floor.
diagnostic_for: missing faculty assign external grades permission

tas_not_assign_external_grades.description: A user who has both TeachingAssistant and Faculty roles attempts to assign an external grade. Under the repaired reading, the TA restriction applies to all TA-role principals, so the overlap case must not be permitted unless a separately reviewed precedence rule says otherwise.
diagnostic_for: TeachingAssistant role must be excluded from external-grade assignment, including Faculty+TeachingAssistant overlap

students_not_assign_internal_grades.description: A user who is both a Student and a TeachingAssistant attempts to assign an internal grade. The TeachingAssistant floor would otherwise permit this, but the student prohibition on assigning grades should exclude it.
